name: Tetrahydrodeoxycorticosterone
summary: Tetrahydrodeoxycorticosterone (abbreviated as THDOC; 3α,21-dihydroxy-5α-pregnan-20-one), also referred to as allotetrahydrocorticosterone, is an endogenous neurosteroid. It is synthesized from the adrenal hormone deoxycorticosterone by the action of two enzymes, 5α-reductase type I and 3α-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase.

pharmacology.text: THDOC is a potent positive allosteric modulator of the GABAA receptor, and has sedative, anxiolytic and anticonvulsant effects.

uses.en: It is a natural brain chemical studied in research on stress, anxiety and epilepsy. It is not used as a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是一種天然的腦內化學物質，用於壓力、焦慮與癲癇的相關研究，不作為藥物使用。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种天然的脑内化学物质，用于压力、焦虑与癫痫的相关研究，不作为药物使用。

fact.en: THDOC is made in the body from an adrenal hormone, and its levels rise during stress. This may be one of the ways the brain calms itself after a stressful event.
fact.zh: THDOC在體內由一種腎上腺激素轉化而來，壓力時濃度會上升，這可能是大腦在壓力事件後讓自己平靜下來的方式之一。
fact.zhHans: THDOC在体内由一种肾上腺激素转化而来，压力时浓度会上升，这可能是大脑在压力事件后让自己平静下来的方式之一。
